02/16.04.2024
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner as well as the learned counsel for the respondent State.

2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Godda (Mahila) P.S. Case No. 01 of 2024, for the offence registered under Sections 376(2)(k), 376(2)(n), 313 and 493 of Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of learned C.J.M., Godda.
3. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the victim is an aged lady and she was already married.
The false allegations are made of physical relationship.
He submits that further allegations are made that on false pretext of marriage the relationship was established.
He submits that belatedly the FIR was registered.
4. Learned State counsel opposed the prayer on the ground that allegation is there.
5. Looking into the contents of the FIR, it transpires that the victim was pregnant for one and half months and on the false pretext of marriage the relationship was established.

The relationship may be consensual at the beginning but the same state may not remain so far all times to come, whenever one of the partner show their willingness to continue with such relationship, the character of such relationship as it was when started will not continue to run and there is direct allegation against the Chandan Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand

6. In the attending facts and circumstances, I am not inclined to grant privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner, and hence, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner, is, hereby, rejected.
Accordingly, this anticipatory bail application is hereby dismissed.

(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Sangam/
